name: Snowdrift
source:
After humans won the war against the invading, humanoid aliens, certain parts of the planet were plunged into perpetual winter, due to the core of the invaders' mothership exploding. The protagonist, Arrim, lives in one of these places.

One day, while walking through a blizzard, he comes across what he thinks is a person, almost completely buried in the snow. Thankfully, this turns out to be a robot, rather than someone at death's door. The female robot is clearly a servant, however, and one who's owner has been relying on her, to fetch food.

Thankfully, the robot is functional enough to speak, and Arrim is able to bring her, as well as her food, back to her starving mistress.

The robot's wheelchair-bound mistress, Rosim, thanks Arrim and welcomes him into her mansion, asking him to care for her while she repairs her robot servant, Sapphire.

And so, their relationship begins…

[From [url=https://overlooked-option-vns.itch.io/snowdrift-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在人类赢得对抗入侵的人形外星人的战争后，由于入侵者母舰的核心爆炸，地球的某些地区陷入了永久的冬天。主角阿里姆就住在其中一处。

有一天，当他走过暴风雪时，他发现了一个他认为几乎完全埋在雪里的人。值得庆幸的是，事实证明这是一个机器人，而不是一个濒临死亡的人。然而，这个女性机器人显然是一个仆人，而主人一直依靠她来取食物。

值得庆幸的是，这个机器人有足够的功能可以说话，阿里姆能够把她和她的食物带回她饥饿的女主人身边。

机器人坐在轮椅上的情妇罗西姆感谢阿里姆，并欢迎他进入她的豪宅，并请他在她修理机器人仆人蓝宝石时照顾她。

于是，他们的关系开始了……
